quantity: time course of IL-6 and CRP after a defined inflammatory stimulus, with the dose recorded
resolution_required: >= 6 time points per subject; inter-individual SD reported
dataset_type: human endotoxin challenge or ACS cohort with serial sampling
why_it_is_the_target: the model predicts a SHAPE, and shape is what a single terminal value cannot test; without a time course the ODE is unfalsifiable

quantity: effect of a specific NLRP3 or IL-1b inhibitor on the same time course
why_it_is_the_target: the model has ONE knobs-per-mechanism structure with no dose-response; a randomised dose-response is the only data that can reject it

quantity: paired cap thickness and LDL on the same patients over time
dataset_type: serial OCT or IVUS cohort with paired lipids
why_it_is_the_target: the plaque model predicts cap thinning as a function of LDL; no dataset here pairs the two longitudinally, so the relation is asserted

quantity: randomised LVEF and outcome data for a cell-therapy arm versus guideline therapy
resolution_required: >= 26 per arm for LVEF; a mortality endpoint for outcome
dataset_type: randomised controlled trial with an outcome endpoint
why_it_is_the_target: the model's central claim is about an uncontrolled observation; only a control arm can price it, and none exists

quantity: measured efficacy of two of the combined mechanisms administered together
why_it_is_the_target: the interaction terms are the entire justification for refusing additivity; they are measured in THIS model and nowhere in humans

quantity: adverse-event rate for the delivery procedure with a defined denominator
why_it_is_the_target: 28 patients across two trials give no denominator; a rate cannot be estimated from single-arm counts, only assumed

quantity: independent measurements of >= 3 species in the chain simultaneously
resolution_required: 3 independent observables, which would give 3 identifiable directions against the 1 currently available
dataset_type: multiplex cytokine panel with absolute quantification
why_it_is_the_target: the cascade has 14 rates and 1 usable observable; each additional independent species removes one degree of structural blindness
